contract.title: Implement frozen bootstrap dispatch authority and state model
acceptance_criteria: Define BootstrapDispatchAuthorityV1 and BootstrapDispatchClaimV1 with canonical SHA-256 identity
Persist claims before side effects under runtime/bootstrap-dispatch-claims and append immutable state evidence
Allow only DISCOVERED to VERIFIED to CLAIMED to EXECUTING to REVIEW_REQUIRED to ACTIVATED to CONSUMED transitions with BLOCKED terminal failure
Bind exclusively to INFRA-0011 parent INFRA-0002 WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_OWNER and exact HEAD and scope
Reject replay expiry ambiguity mismatch and generic task use
Recover interrupted execution fail closed and require review before activation
Add adversarial tests for all bindings and parent immutability
